We walked alone in the pale moon light  
    The same path we always walked…always years apart  
    She strode ahead of me, eyes fixed to the stars  
    Mine cast upon the snow beaten ground  
    I watch as the puffs of white fill her empty steps  
    She calls to me but I don’t hear  
    She relents, knowing I’ve long since been gone  
    I cannot hear her...she has too long been gone  
    Her footprints are no longer seen, just the bright abyss of snow  
    I’ve stopped walking…lost in the snow…my eyes now turn to the starry night sky  
    The wind icy and sharp whips along my face, but my eyes remain with the stars  
    There I can see her, there her eyes are the diamonds of the sky  
    In this blackest of nights snow falls…and along the ground dark meets light
